items.title: I Turned a Bomber Into a Flying Battleship
items.description:
Gaijin buffed bombers in War Thunder, so I turned the BV 238 into a gunship. With 16 machine guns and two 20mm cannons, this massive German flying boat is getting a new job: hunting fighters and shooting down enemy CAS.

Bombing bases can wait. Today, I’m taking advantage of the bomber survivability changes to use the BV 238 as a flying anti-air battery. Its defensive turrets are getting a very offensive assignment, and apparently bringing a boat to an air battle is now a legitimate strategy.
